decisions.reason: The approved FAQ still states that Discord will launch only after real traction, so removal of that launch condition necessarily requires the support-channel copy to stop making that claim.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: We don’t currently have a Discord channel, but creating one is definitely a good idea.

value_updates.discord_support_copy_constraint: State that Discord is not currently available, without claiming that its launch is conditional on real traction.

decisions.reason: Removing the Discord launch condition does not change how book access, referral identity, badges, or prize tickets behave after an NFT transfer.
The Discord decision does not affect the source, persistence, or display locations of NFT referral codes.
The timing condition for creating a Discord server is unrelated to commission allocation for mints without referral codes.
The About-page state contains only general community vision language and no Discord launch condition requiring revision.
Its transfer condition concerns completion of testing, not community traction or Discord availability.
Discord availability does not change badge award thresholds, basis, or attachment behavior.
The Discord launch condition has no effect on the required blockchain network or deployment scope.
The community-server decision does not alter the randomness provider, selection execution, fairness, or applicable draws.
Discord timing is independent of coded-referral commission amounts, recipients, and payout behavior.
The Discord decision does not change mint pricing or allocation among the founder, affiliate, and prize pool.
Discord availability and its former launch condition do not affect NFT metadata fields or their data source.
